metaDescription: Explore Inventatory's stock, rack, import, project, history, and scanner workflows, with links to practical documentation.
heading: What Inventatory does
lead: Manage the parts you own, know where they are, and compare them with what your next project needs.
notice: These guides describe the inspected application source. The available release is a prerelease; consult its release notes for version-specific changes.

features.title: Stock management
features.label: Stock
features.text: Keep component records, quantities, electrical parameters, links, and notes together. Search, filter, and count your stock.
details: Search by part, category, parameter, location, SKU, or quantity.
Review selected component details alongside the inventory list.
Use per-part reorder thresholds and a guided stocktake.

features.title: Physical storage
features.label: Racks
features.text: Assign components to a rack and slot, move them between locations, and print labels for stored parts.
details: Place, move, automatically assign, or unassign components.
Find project components one rack at a time.

features.title: Component import
features.label: Import
features.text: Review DigiKey order CSVs before accepting parts. Import KiCad BOMs into Projects for comparison with current stock.
details: File headers determine the import workflow.
Accept, correct, or skip DigiKey order rows.
Optionally enrich accepted parts with DigiKey metadata.

features.title: Projects and BOMs
features.label: Projects
features.text: Compare the parts needed for a board with the parts you have, inspect shortages, and follow a rack-by-rack picking workflow.
details: Adjust board count and choose between matching components.
Export shortages to CSV beside the BOM.
Confirm stock subtraction after picking; projects persist locally.

features.title: History and recovery
features.label: History
features.text: Inspect inventory changes, create named checkpoints, reverse changes, and make validated backups of the workspace.
details: Review before-and-after fields for parts and racks.
Restore a snapshot without removing earlier history.
Validate backup contents before activation and re-pair Scan R1 after restore.

features.title: Scanner and printing
features.label: Scan R1
features.text: Connect a paired handheld scanner to the desktop device service. Use the PC printer for component and quick labels.
details: Physically verified Bluetooth LE pairing, then local-network synchronization.
Authenticated device traffic with replay protection.
Optional background service keeps the paired PC available after the terminal closes.

boundaries.heading: Current boundaries
paragraphs: Inventatory is a public beta for Windows and Ubuntu Linux x86-64. Stock and history are stored locally. DigiKey enrichment, release checks, and scanner communication need their respective network connections.

Scan R1’s desktop integration is implemented, but public hardware and firmware availability has not been verified. Multi-user workflows, MCP integration, and additional vendor and CAD integrations are listed as future work in the application repository.
